Question: “神舟六号”飞船从发射至返回的各阶段中，机械能守恒的是____
Options:
A. 加速升空阶段
B. 在圆轨道绕地球运行阶段
C. 进入大气层减速阶段
D. 降落伞张开后下降阶段

Need choose correct. Mechanical energy conservation? For spacecraft. In round orbit around Earth: if no atmospheric drag, only gravity conservative, mechanical energy (kinetic + gravitational potential) conserved. In circular orbit speed constant, potential constant, total constant. Actually in ideal circular orbit mechanical energy conserved. Accelerating ascent: engines do work, mechanical energy increases. Entering atmosphere deceleration: air resistance dissipates, mechanical energy decreases. Parachute descent: air resistance, mechanical energy not conserved. So B.
